children: The impact of WebBeds' Spanish tax audit is simple to assess despite the travel booker's failure to well explain the issue, Morgan Stanley analysts say. With an unchanged equal-weight rating on the stock, the analysts summarize the financial impact on the Australian company as a one-off provision of 50 million Australian dollars and an annual revenue hit of A$14 million. It's not ideal but it is straightforward, they tell clients in a note. More positively, they say that take rates have held up well given momentum a couple of years ago. MS lowers its target price by 11% to A$2.90. Shares are flat at A$2.60. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
